name: dsh-session-inherit
description: Inherit a long DeepSeek Harness session into a clean one: adds an "Inherit" row to the session "..." menu, mechanically extracts concrete anchors (task, recent instructions, touched files, commands, todos) from the source session log without calling an LLM, creates a brand-new session in the same workspace and sends that handoff as its first message.

scripts.test: node test/extract.test.mjs && node test/host.test.mjs && node test/client.test.mjs
